report.summary: Impact between car-0 and motorcycle-0 occurred at t = 4.726 s. From t = 3.526 to 4.526 s, car-0 travelled at 53.2 km/h (90% interval 50.2 to 57.7) and motorcycle-0 travelled at 36.1 km/h (90% interval 33.8 to 39.1). The stated speed by s1 was not consistent with the footage, while the stated speed by s2 was consistent with the footage. The statement by s2 about braking was consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact. The claim by s1 that the light was green cannot be checked from the footage.
